label: Size Chart
purpose: Display a size chart popup for apparel and sizing information
_notes:
button_label and table_header_content are inline_richtext (no

wrapping, inline tags like are fine); table_content and caption_text are richtext and MUST be wrapped in

tags. table_header_content is a COMMA-SEPARATED list of column headers (default 'Size, Chest, Length, Shoulder'). table_content should be one

per row, each row a comma-separated list matching the column count/order of table_header_content (default: '

S, 95cm, 61cm, 44cm

M, 102cm, 66cm, 46cm

...'). button_icon is a Material Symbols icon name; button_custom_icon overrides it with an image. top_image/bottom_image are optional supporting images shown above/below the table. Can be nested inside the Variant Picker block. Excluded as pure visual/technical: test_mode, button_filled_icon, text_size, button_alignment, button_underline, heading_size, close_button_style, color_scheme, table_header_color_scheme, caption_size/color/alignment, margins.
